full_judgment: 16. The essentials of a marriage mentioned in paragraph 252 by M. Hidayatullah on Mulla's principles of Muhammad an Law are based on the arguments made in Moung Kyi vs Ma Shwe Baw (1929) 7 Rang 777, 121 IC 718, Gagu Bibi vs Mesal Shaikh (1936) 63 cal 415 and 164 IC 957. In the absence of witnesses to the marriage, Mulla says in paragraph 254 "A marriage contracted without witnesses as required by sec. 252 is irregular, but not void."
